title: Foreign payment cards and e-money spent in Thailand
release_schedule: quarterly within second month after quarter; annual in February following year; monthly table publicly available
reporting_population: banks;specialized financial institutions;non-banks reporting under Payment Systems Act B.E. 2560 (2017)
dimensions: cash withdrawal; cash advance; credit EFTPOS; credit online acquired by Thai acquirers; debit EFTPOS; debit online acquired by Thai acquirers; foreign e-money POS
methodology: BOT aggregates volume and value of foreign payment-card and e-money transactions reported by regulated payment providers and classifies by instrument/channel
revision_policy: revised when updated data become available
limitations: foreign-issued payment activity is not tourist count or total tourist spend; online transactions may occur without physical travel; cash withdrawal/advance are not merchant spend; origin country is not provided in confirmed table

title: Thai payment cards spent abroad
release_schedule: public monthly table; metadata confirms official BOT source and revision on updated data
reporting_population: Bank of Thailand payment statistics reporting framework
dimensions: cash withdrawal; cash advance; credit EFTPOS abroad; credit online acquired by foreign acquirers; debit EFTPOS abroad; debit online acquired by foreign acquirers
methodology: BOT separates point-of-sale abroad from online transactions acquired by foreign acquirers for Thai credit/debit cards
revision_policy: revised when updated data become available
limitations: foreign merchant online spend is not pure tourism; transaction location/acquirer definition differs from traveler destination; no destination-country split in confirmed table
